scope: All 15 frozen Go corpus cases freshly rerun at the same final engine revision with runtime_observation=true. Original corpus logs, metadata, expected answers and manifest unchanged. Diagnosis receives no upstream fix or scorer ground truth.
verification_contract: A supported typed assertion contract identifies a constant expected value and the direct scalar actual call.
An injected begin/end span evaluates the original actual expression exactly once and records the exact subtest.
Exactly one selected error-return event occurs within that span on the same goroutine and carries a non-nil error.

Runtime caller functions match the exact SSA return path. Each transparent wrapper has a unique producing call site and no unresolved call, deferred mutation, memory load or later branch in the proven return path.
The observed error-return value reaches the actual call unchanged through exact scalar/tuple return slots.
The precise original assertion location and subtest have the same expected/actual failure signature as the rerun.
Source, declaration, revision, binary SHA-256, correlation and mechanism evidence are retained and cited. PR attribution and fix verification are separate claims.
limitations: This establishes a bounded scalar error-return mechanism class, not general Go root-cause coverage.
Only supported testify assert.Equal/require.Equal assertions with constant expected values and a direct scalar actual call admit invocation verification. Other assertion forms remain observations.
Aliases, unresolved interface dispatch, deferred mutation, multiple producing call sites, callbacks, recursion, asynchronous paths and incomplete return proofs abstain.
Fixture copies preserve bounded data and repository-local relative symlinks; external links and oversized copies are refused.
Total diagnosis time includes probe work; separate probe build/run duration is not exposed by current reports and is left null rather than estimated.
